requirement: Why does a front-window exist at all for relationship evidence retrieval? Investigate whether structural navigation (caption/recitals/amendment-clauses/document-identity-refs with a bounded total context budget) can replace the fixed-offset window, rather than simply enlarging the constant.

confirmedByDirectSourceRead.windowMechanism: lib/contract-model/compiler/package-graph/relationship-resolution.ts:382-384: `const bigWindowTypes: DocumentType[] = ["INTERCREDITOR_AGREEMENT", "GUARANTEE", "SECURITY_AGREEMENT", "GUARANTEE_AND_SECURITY_AGREEMENT"]; const windowChars = bigWindowTypes.includes(classification.type) ? 8000 : 4000;` - a fixed, hardcoded per-document-type allowlist and two magic-number character counts. `AMENDED_AND_RESTATED_AGREEMENT` (doc-b's own classified type, confirmed correct as of Mission 2's classifier fix) is NOT in bigWindowTypes, so it gets the default 4000-char window regardless of how long its own front matter actually is.
confirmedByDirectSourceRead.recitalDetection: relationship-resolution.ts:170-181 findRecitalBounds() searches ONLY for the literal keyword `WHEREAS` (WHEREAS_RE = /\bWHEREAS\b/i, line 170) to find recital-block boundaries within the (already-windowed) text. It has no fallback for any other real drafting convention.
confirmedByDirectSourceRead.documentIdentityHasTheSameClassOfBug: lib/contract-model/compiler/package-graph/document-identity.ts:10 also defines its own, SEPARATE fixed PREAMBLE_WINDOW = 4000 constant, and its executionDate extraction regex (line 38: `dated (?:as of )?(${DATE_RE.source})`) uses LITERAL ASCII SPACES between 'dated' and '(as of)?' rather than \s+ - the exact same whitespace-intolerance defect class Mission 2 already fixed once in document-classifier.ts, recurring independently in a second module.
confirmedByDirectSourceRead.structuralIndexAlreadyHasTheRightPrimiti: lib/contract-model/compiler/structural-index.ts:217/219 exposes `searchStructuralNodes(predicate)` and `allNodes()`, both operating over StructuralNode objects that carry real charStart/charEnd spans (compiler/types.ts:70: `nodeType: "ARTICLE" | "SECTION" | "SUBSECTION" | "CLAUSE" | "SUBCLAUSE"`), sorted by charStart (structural-index.ts:280). relationship-resolution.ts has ZERO wiring to a StructuralIndex today - it operates purely on raw `doc.text` strings with regex + a magic-number slice.

liveReproductionEvidence.method: An Explore agent ran the real, unmodified production relationship-resolution.ts and document-identity.ts against the real Superior doc-a and doc-b text (not a hypothetical) during this mission's research phase.
findings: doc-b's real recital heading is 'PRELIMINARY STATEMENTS', not 'WHEREAS' - findRecitalBounds's keyword-only detection fails to recognize doc-b's recital block AT ALL, independent of window size. Widening windowChars alone would NOT fix this specific document's recital detection.

doc-a's real execution-date text does not match document-identity.ts:38's literal-space regex (the real source line-wraps or otherwise breaks the literal 'dated as of' sequence the same way the ORIGINAL Mission-2-fixed classifier bug did) - executionDate resolves to null for doc-a today, capping any relationship resolution that depends on execution-date matching at REVIEW_REQUIRED (type-only match) rather than RESOLVED, REGARDLESS of whether the window/recital-detection issues above are fixed.
liveReproductionEvidence.conclusion: Widening windowChars to a larger constant (even a generously large one) would NOT, by itself, produce a correct resolution for Superior's real doc-b -> doc-a RESTATES relationship: it would still miss the PRELIMINARY STATEMENTS recital (a keyword-detection gap) and would still be blocked by document-identity.ts's independent whitespace bug on doc-a's execution date. Both are real, separate, generalizable defects - not artifacts of an under-sized window alone.

whyAFrontWindowExistsAtAll: The window was originally introduced (per the module's own comments, e.g. relationship-resolution.ts:147's reference to 'PKG-01's counterexample') as a cheap, bounded-cost heuristic proxy for 'the caption/recitals/preamble zone where agreement-identity references legitimately live, as opposed to incidental mentions deep in operative covenant text that should NOT be treated as relationship evidence.' The intent (bounding scan scope to avoid false-positive relationship inference from an incidental mid-document mention) is sound and must be preserved; the IMPLEMENTATION (a raw character count with a hardcoded document-type allowlist) is what is fragile - it has no relationship to where the document's own actual structure places its preamble/recital zone, so it silently under- or over-shoots per document.
rootCauseClassification: BOUNDED_ARCHITECTURAL_LIMITATION (the character-window heuristic, used generically to approximate 'preamble/recital zone', is a structurally-blind proxy for a concept - document front matter - that the codebase already has a precise, generic, structural representation for via StructuralIndex's ARTICLE/SECTION nodes) plus one independent, unrelated LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT (document-identity.ts's literal-space date regex, the same defect class, different file, as Mission 2's already-fixed document-classifier.ts bug).
